map.由预期股利、要求收益率与增长率求股价: Compute stock price from expected dividend, required return and growth rate
map.输入预期每股股利 D₁、要求收益率 r 与股利增长率 g，求合理股价。: Enter expected dividend per share D1, required return r and dividend growth rate g to find the fair stock price.
map.📖 查看「由预期股利、要求收益率与增长率求股价 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compute stock price from expected dividend, required return and growth rate User Guide"
map.📚 深度解析：戈登增长模型定价: 📚 Deep Dive: Gordon Growth Model Valuation
map.稳定增长股的内在价值估算（P=D₁/(r−g)）。: Intrinsic value estimate for stable-growth stocks (P = D1/(r-g)).
map.与 DDM 等价，常用于股息贴现教学与估值。: Equivalent to DDM; commonly used in dividend-discount teaching and valuation.
map.敏感性分析：r 与 g 的微小变动对价格影响极大。: Sensitivity analysis: tiny changes in r and g have an enormous impact on price.
map.P = 2.1/(0.10−0.05) = 42 元。若 r 升到 11%：P=: P = 2.1/(0.10-0.05) = 42 yuan. If r rises to 11%: P = 2.1/(0.11-0.05) = 35 yuan; a one-notch spread widens price down 17%.
map.D₁=2.1, r=10%, g=3%：P=2.1/(0.07)=30 元。增长: D1=2.1, r=10%, g=3%: P=2.1/(0.07)=30 yuan. Lower growth means lower valuation.
map.和 DDM 有何不同？: How is it different from DDM?
map.Gordon 增长模型就是单阶段 DDM，公式完全一致，名称不同而已。: The Gordon growth model is exactly the single-stage DDM; the formulas are identical, only the name differs.
map.不能，否则分母为负/零，估值无界。现实中 g 长期不超过名义 GDP 增速。: No; otherwise the denominator is negative/zero and valuation is unbounded. In reality g never exceeds the long-run nominal GDP growth rate.
